title: Full Name
description:
Ask for a first name, then a last name. Print the full name separated by a space.

**Inputs:** `John`, then `Doe`

**Expected output:**
```
John Doe
```
starterCode:
first = input()
last = input()
# Print the full name
hint: Combine first and last with a space: print(first + " " + last) or print(f"{first} {last}")
